features.title: Change camera preview settings
features.expected: Selecting a preview resolution then Initialize Camera applies the chosen preview stream setting; status text reflects success or (no camera) an access/denied message.

features.title: Change preview and photo settings
features.expected: Preview and photo stream resolutions can be set independently; Take Photo captures at the selected photo resolution once a camera is initialized.

features.title: Match aspect ratios
features.expected: Video stream aspect ratio is matched to the preview stream; Record Video records at the matched aspect ratio once a camera is initialized.

notes: Every scenario shares the Initialize Camera action and a Status output region. All device operations are camera-hardware-gated; on a box with no camera the expected observable is a visible 'denied access to the camera' status rather than a crash.
